shortDescription: Kenya's central bank will hold its next interest rate-setting meeting on October 7, the bank said on its website on Tuesday.At its last meeting in August the Central Bank of Kenya held its benchmark lending rate (KECBIR=ECI) at 8.75%.

children: Kenya's central bank will hold its next interest rate-setting meeting on October 7, the bank said on its website on Tuesday.
At its last meeting in August the Central Bank of Kenya held its benchmark lending rate (KECBIR=ECI) at 8.75%.
